scope: Direct visual inspection of final published 128px atlases, 10 contact sheets, four walk rows at phases 0/4/8/12/16/20/24/28 and four acting rows of eight poses at beat 2.
observations: All ten existing One Piece characters are identifiable and keep independently drawn head/body/feet orientation in every direction.
Side gait samples exchange front/back legs through a passing pose, with small vertical foot clearance and stable skull scale.
North/south samples alternate support and advance under the body without a front face painted on the back head.
No detached head/shoulder holes, stationary duplicate thighs, or obvious extra arms are visible in selected phases.
Expressions change on the actual character; gestures move arms and retain clothing accessories.
Zoro white-shirt era has two intact eyes; Sanji left eye is covered; asymmetric swords/earrings/Usopp bag remain on consistent anatomical sides.
Brook remains a skeleton in his tailcoat, and Jinbe keeps his fishman face, kimono and cape.
limits: Temporal sampling of published pixels. Does not by itself certify continuous runtime routes, furniture contact, human testing or deployment. Those are separate gates.

sanjiFocusedUseRecheck.observation: Final east/west cooking pose extends both arms in facing direction; costume and head remain aligned, walking rows unchanged. Furniture surface alignment is a separate runtime gate.
